question: 12 men and 16 boys can do a piece of work in 5 days, while 13 men and 24 boys can do it in 4 days. In how many days can 29 men and 22 boys complete the work?
solution: **Given:** (12 men + 16 boys) can do a piece of work = 5 days (13 men + 24 boys) can do a piece of work = 4 days **Formula used:** Total work = efficiency × time **Calculation:** Let, the efficiency of man = M The efficiency of boy = B According to the question: ⇒ (12 M + 16 B) × 5 = (13 M + 24 B) × 4 ⇒ 60 M - 52 M = 96 B - 80 B
